svg.title: MetaHarness cinematic trailer
svg.desc: 32-second illustrative tour: Begin with your repository. Repository analysis produces a recommendation before scaffolding.. Bring your preferred host. The same generated harness connects through distinct host adapters.. Evolve the harness. Darwin evaluates harness changes behind sandbox and safety gates.. Ship it under your name. Customize, validate, then publish the package under your chosen scope.. Reduced motion shows the first chapter; all chapters are available separately with text.
